title: milyen? — Asking What Someone Is Like

sections.content: milyen? asks for a description — a quality — answered with an adjective. Like ki?/mi?, it needs no copula in the answer.
sections.title: Describing people and things

items.english: What is he like? He is tall.
What is the boy like? Young.

sections.content: Zero copula strikes again with adjectives too, but only in the 3rd person: Ő magas, never Ő van magas. In 1st and 2nd person, lenni comes back: Én magas vagyok (I am tall), Te magas vagy (You are tall).
